notes: *to* in *hold to one* is given to the genitive ἑνός as the case preposition (rules 21, 106), the ASV having written an English verb word of its own for the compound; reading it as the verb's phrasal particle remains defensible.
οὐ δύνασθε is spelled solid as *cannot* and stays one aligned unit under rule 39, the supplied subject riding along.
Οὐδείς → *No man* heads on *No*, *man* being the generic completion (rules 17, 69).
